# houle.ai

> houle is an independent, vendor-neutral AI consulting and integration firm based in Geneva, Switzerland (a brand of West-Bay SA). It helps organisations choose the use cases worth automating and the right model for each of them: Microsoft or OpenAI where it fits, Anthropic or Mistral, or open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) hosted in Switzerland when data residency, professional or medical secrecy, cost or independence matter.

The site is available in French (master), English, German, Spanish and Portuguese under /fr/, /en/, /de/, /es/ and /pt/.

## What houle does

- AI consulting: discovery workshop, use-case selection, model and hosting choice (proprietary or open source), measured pilot, production, governance.
- Case and document triage: an AI model sorts incoming cases into those that meet the client's own rules for a simple path and the few that need human review. Rules and thresholds are set by the client, not by the model.
- Open-source models hosted in Switzerland: self-hosted or in a Swiss cloud. For each project houle documents where inference runs, where data is stored, who has access and what is logged.
- Microsoft 365 expertise: Azure, Power Automate, SharePoint, Power BI, SPFx. One competence among others.
- Ready-to-use products for teams working in Microsoft 365: AI add-ins for Outlook and Word, AI agents, and Swiss GPT, a private GPT platform.

houle does not claim certifications or turnkey compliance. Hosting in Switzerland simplifies a client's own legal analysis; it does not replace it.
